facts.material: zinc alloy and stainless steel, replaceable utility blade
facts.function: manual cutting of cardboard, plastic and similar; locking mechanism and quick blade change
facts.form: folding knife with locking blade, spare blade and attached screwdriver

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8211 covers knives with cutting blades other than fixed-blade knives of 8208; chapter 82 note 1 satisfied (base metal blade)
GRI 6: 8211.93 knives having other than fixed blades; .00.35 pen knives, pocket knives and other knives which have folding blades

rejected_alternatives.reason: folding two-handled multi-use tools; the screwdriver is a minor attachment, not a multi-tool with tools housed in handles
replacement blades separately entered; blade here is part of a complete knife

classification.rationale: N361367 classified a nearly identical manually operated folding utility knife with a locking replaceable blade in 8211.93.0035. The attached screwdriver does not change the essential character of a folding knife.
